papers.title: Dozer: Debiased personalized gene co-expression networks for population-scale scRNA-seq data.

1.genes: SET: Dozer-A3 module, 57 genes, plotted in Fig 5D hive plot and Supplementary Figs S19-S21 (no table named)
1.conditions: late-stage Alzheimer disease vs age-matched cognitively healthy controls
1.metric: module density: mean absolute Dozer-debiased Pearson correlation over the module's gene pairs, per donor network; t-test
1.where: abstract; results, 'Differential analysis of personalized co-expression networks uniquely identifies a dense innate immune response module...', Fig 5B
1.quote: we asked whether densities (i.e., connectedness) of these modules varied between the two diagnoses and observed that module Dozer-A3, with 57 genes, has significantly higher module density in AD compared to the Control diagnosis
1.data: Morabito 2021 snRNA-seq, Synapse syn22079621
1.donors: 11 AD vs 7 control
1.verdict: in silico: 'we repeated the difference network analysis with Dozer with a restricted ODC cell population excluding the immune ODCs and observed that immune related gene module Dozer-A3 was no longer discoverable'
1.note: Module found on the AD-minus-control difference network of the same data; paper attributes the difference to immune ODCs

2.genes: SET: Dozer-A3 module (innate immune response), 57 genes, Fig 5D hive plot and Supplementary Figs S19-S21 (gene-level plots; no table named)
2.conditions: late-stage Alzheimer's disease (group 1) vs age-matched cognitively healthy controls (group 2)
2.direction: module density higher in AD
2.metric: module density: mean absolute Dozer-debiased gene-gene correlation within the module, per-donor networks, t-test across donors
2.where: abstract; Results, Differential analysis of personalized co-expression networks (AD), Fig 5B
2.quote: observed that module Dozer-A3, with 57 genes, has significantly higher module density in AD compared to the Control diagnosis (Figure 5B, t-test p-value of 0.0084)
2.data: Morabito et al. 2021 snRNA-seq, Synapse syn22079621
2.donors: 11 AD vs 7 control donors (C(18,7)=31824)
2.verdict: in silico only: with immune ODCs excluded, "immune related gene module Dozer-A3 was no longer discoverable" and no module differed in connectivity between Control and AD
2.note: Module selected by clustering the AD-minus-control difference network, then tested on the same donors (circular); authors attribute the density gap to immune ODCs (composition).

claims.set_where: plotted in Fig 5D hive plot and Supplementary Figs S19-S21
claims.genes_from: not listed: shown only in figures (Fig. 5D; Supplementary Figs S19-S21, the supplement a PDF of figures)
